quarterly_data.signal: IBM (10-Q): Consulting backlog was $30.8 billion at June 30, 2026, with trailing twelve-month book-to-bill of approximately 1.05 and H1 Consulting signings of $10,388 million (+6.8%). First-half 2026 revenue was $33,079 million (+5.0%); in Q2, Distributed Infrastructure revenue rose 37.3% while IBM Z fell 42.0%, and H1 Infrastructure revenue of $7,161 million rose 1.9% on double-digit growth in Power and Storage. Q2 R&D expense rose 10.2%, driven by investments in AI, hybrid cloud and quantum.
